text_block_list.text:
Summer camp finally reached its last day.
Since everyone was having a barbecue that night,
I went along with Shinko Windy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, great job on summer training camp♪
To reward everyone for their hard work~... Cheers☆

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Cheeeers☆

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Meat! Meaty-meat, yummy meat!
Minion, grab those spare ribs over there!
choice_data_list: Make sure to eat calmly, okay?

text_block_list.text:
—And after eating our fill,
the conversation naturally shifted toward races and our future...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: —Huh, Windy-senpai, your next goal is the Champions Cup, huh?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Indeed! I'm gonna spook a whole bunch of people in a big, high-profile race~!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. So, you wanted your infamy to spread far and wide someday, was it?
You're working really hard, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh! That's right!
Windy-chan is bad to the bone!
I'm gonna make everyone shake in their boots~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's not all.
Windy-chan's ambitions are
way, waaaay bigger!"
"There's no way I could forget. Her precious, ultimate goal..."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
“Talked about 100 years from now
as the top of the all-time strongest Umamusume rankings”...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
That's the kind of Umamusume I'm gonna become!
The scaaaaariest Umamusume who'll still be getting all the hype even a hundred years from now~~~!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Ooooohhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh!
How's that, pretty amazing, huh?!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's a big dream...
Have you set any concrete goals
on how to get there?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Nu...? Con-crete...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I was just wondering,
how do you actually know
when a dream "comes true"?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guh...! Now that you mention it. That's pretty sharp of you, Tarumae...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Umm, let's see... Winning and winning, getting talked about... and then...
what should I do next...?
Even the ranking we saw back then was just one of many independently published by various media outlets each year.

To keep drawing attention even 100 years from now,
I might need some kind of "solid achievement"
that goes down in the official records...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I know! How about winning a URA Award?
Let's aim for "Best Dirt Horse Girl"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Best Dirt Umamusume... Oho.
That's the annual award from the URA, right?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, isn't that nice?
Having the URA praise you directly
is quite an honor, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah!
Winning an award means your name goes down in the official records!
Actually, I want one too...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Falco saw posts on social media saying,
"With these results, Windy could actually
take it this year"!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Hmm...
URA's Best Dirt Umamusume, huh...
......"
Just as the cleanup was wrapping up, Shinko Windy was seen casually wandering off somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Nrrrgh...
Best Dirt Umamusume, Best Dirt Umamusume, huh...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Minion... Leave Windy-chan alone. Windy-chan is doing some deep thinking.
choice_data_list: Are you talking about the Best Dirt Category Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Do you think... I should aim for that too?
choice_data_list: ...You really don't think so, do you?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~~~, like, you know...
Are awards really that big of a deal?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Windy-chan doesn't want to be praised
from on high by a bunch of big shots."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Not because "the officials decided it," but... naturally, on their own... everyone starts buzzing, going "Whoa, that's amazing!"...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"And then look my way and fawn all over me...
...Something like that would be so great!"
choice_data_list: So that's how it is, huh...

text_block_list.text:
What she wanted was spontaneous praise and attention.
Not an authoritative award...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If I can get it, I'll be glad to receive it, you know?
It's an incredible award, after all.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: But, well... Mmmgh!

Her dream really is,
after all, to be one-of-a-kind rather than number one.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Well, no point worrying before I even receive it.
Besides, what I need to do remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
I'll do my best and win. Win, win, win...!
Awards don't matter.
I'll put up great results and steal all the spotlight!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
If they're gonna give me the Best Dirt Umamusume award
for that... well, I guess I'll take it.

If you win it, it'll count as an 'award-winning' achievement,
and there's no doubt the public will praise you for it.

"Still, it's not as if we'll be able to leave
the 'powerful impression' she's hoping for..."

Right...
If that's the case, then why not—!
choice_data_list: What do you mean, win it just to 'decline' it?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Withdraw...?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Withdraw...? Has anyone
ever done something like that before?"

Her dream is "to stand out more than anyone."
For that, she needs to become a hot topic.

"Withdrawing... felt like
the perfect 'dramatic effect.'"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! I see, a performance...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"So you're saying we should use this award
to make Windy-chan stand out?"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Uwooh...! That's way past just being surprised!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: It's completely unprecedented!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Yooou... You've got an evil look on your faaace...!
choice_data_list: Haha... Maybe you're rubbing off on me.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Withdrawing... surely,
only Windy-chan could pull something like that off nanoda."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the evil chief strategist
personally chosen by Windy-chan!
What great creativity! I shall praise you for that!
...To my surprise, I found myself just as thrilled as she was.
I want to get back at the public and the people who treated her like a meme...!

I want to show her strength what's what
and make her eat her words!!
choice_data_list: ...Stepping down is the first step toward ambition.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I see, I see... And then!?

First, draw massive attention
with the overwhelming impact of declining the award.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!!

And I'll do even more amazing things,
creating countless legends...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Make a legeeeeend...!!?
choice_data_list: Let's head toward our true ambition!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Toward my ambition!!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Trainer...! You really are something else...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufufu...
Fufufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Fuhahahahahaaaaah!
Wahhahhahaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: All right, I'm on board!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Together... we'll take a bite out of the world!
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's blow them all away!!
Yeah! Let's make them eat their words!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah!
I'm gonna make 'em eat their words big time-noda!"

And so, the top-secret prank operation began.
If she also takes 1st place in the "Champions Cup,"
her chances of being nominated as Best Dirt Umamusume are high.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"Listen up, minion.
This is a top-secret mission."

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"First, I gotta get picked for the award!
I'll win like my life depends on it! I'm def-i-nite-ly gonna win!!"

The next target is the Champions Cup.
To make this strategy a success, we have to win, no matter what—!
